promotion: Ten validated collision-free skill packages and five exercised shared runners only; no incumbent overwrite.

skills.name: ghc-family-cbor-evidence-profile
skills.purpose: Freeze exact CBOR bytes for finite JSON-shaped evidence and refuse values outside the declared interchange profile.

skills.name: ghc-family-msgpack-evidence-profile
skills.purpose: Freeze MessagePack bytes separately from CBOR and preserve scalar types and integer limits.

skills.name: ghc-family-jsonl-frame-contract
skills.purpose: Read a bounded sequence without silently skipping invalid, empty, duplicate-key, or nonfinite records.

skills.name: ghc-family-json-key-uniqueness
skills.purpose: Reject duplicate decoded keys and nonfinite values before evidence can be assigned a stable meaning.

skills.name: ghc-family-unicode-byte-distinction
skills.purpose: Report original and normalized bytes while refusing to infer identity equivalence from normalization.

skills.name: ghc-family-record-digest-envelope
skills.purpose: Bind a digest to one explicit byte domain; a matching digest supplies no authority or real-world verification.

skills.name: ghc-family-receipt-scope-join
skills.purpose: Require owner, phase, head, scope, result, and evidence class to match before granting local-only receipt credit.

skills.name: ghc-family-event-prefix-reducer
skills.purpose: Reduce a synthetic ordered event prefix and preserve one-send terminal states without performing any live send.

skills.name: ghc-family-checkpoint-byte-boundary
skills.purpose: Accept only exact UTF-8 line boundaries whose committed prefix parses; retain incomplete suffix bytes.

skills.name: ghc-family-artifact-budget-contract
skills.purpose: Keep inclusive file and byte ceilings explicit, reject malformed counts, and recommend rotation at the file boundary.
